subject: [WordPress Credits] Off Example: the Backer term ends on January 21, 2027
body:
Off Example's Backer term ends on January 21, 2027. Renewal is moving the day on the Sponsors screen: https://example.test/wp-admin/admin.php?page=wpcpm-sponsors&tab=sponsors&edit=spoJJJJ0000000009

From the day after, the sponsor reads as a Mentor sponsor, and once the grace date has passed, the daily run puts what a Mentor sponsor's tier does not cover to dormant, while Sponsor tiers is on in Settings.
